flags.why: This confuses liên đoàn with liên chi đoàn, the body linking youth-union chapters ([Youth Union charter](https://thuvienphapluat.vn/van-ban/Bo-may-hanh-chinh/Dieu-le-Doan-Thanh-nien-Cong-san-Ho-Chi-Minh-khoa-X-204237.aspx)).
The example uses lồn as a profane intensifier rather than referring to genitalia.
flags.fix: Đừng sờ vào lồn tao. = Don't touch my cunt.

flags.why: Cừ khôi is colloquial praise, so the literary tag teaches the wrong register ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/C%E1%BB%AB_kh%C3%B4i)).
